content.summary: The Justice and Commerce Departments said that they are investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center company intertwined with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, after reporting suggested an investigation had been halted last year. "While we don't typically comment on ongoing investigations, it is in the public interest to provide the facts and address inaccurate information circulating in public reporting," the departments said in a statement issued Monday evening.
